name: Xero
description: Finance and Fintech: cloud accounting platform for small businesses with REST APIs for invoicing, contacts, bank transactions, payroll and reporting.
access_notes: Developer signup and app registration are free and self-serve (with a free Demo Company for testing). Uncertified apps start on the Starter tier capped at 5 connections (Core tier up to 50 after adding payment details), and each Xero organisation can connect at most 2 uncertified apps; app certification or paid Custom Connections (client_credentials grant) lift these limits. No API-key auth — OAuth 2.0 is required.
mcp_notes: Xero ships an official open-source MCP server (XeroAPI/xero-mcp-server on GitHub, @xeroapi/xero-mcp-server on npm), announced on the Xero Developer blog; Composio has a XERO toolkit (OAUTH2, ~53 tools, not Composio-managed — bring your own OAuth credentials).

evidence.note: 'The Xero API does not support basic API Key authentication. Our API uses OAuth 2.0'; Starter tier default with 5-connection cap, Custom Connections use client credentials grant.
Uncertified app limits: Starter 5 connections, Core 50; each organisation limited to two uncertified apps; no limit for certified apps.
Official Xero MCP server in the XeroAPI GitHub org, OAuth2 custom connections auth.
Xero developer blog announcement of its open-source MCP server integrating with the public API.
Composio Xero toolkit: OAUTH2, slug XERO, tools for invoices, payments, bank transactions, reports (not Composio-managed).
Official webhooks guide: HTTP POST notifications for Contact, Invoice, Credit Note and Subscription create/update events with HMAC signature verification.
